features.name: Cat's Claws
features.description: You can use your claws to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier slashing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

features.name: Feline Senses
features.description: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

features.name: Keen Smell
features.description: You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

conditionalAdvantage.note: VTT should resolve the feature-specific predicate using the named rule hook if direct support is unavailable.

features.name: Catlike Reflexes
features.description: Starting at 5th level, When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.
